findings.title: Later-stage navigation unlocks while preprocessing is running
findings.detail: MutationObserver recorded all four hrefs at 04:21:11.411Z. Status responses at 04:21:10.958Z and 04:21:13.979Z were running, stage3=null. Post-completion and reload assertions passed; the stipulated locked-running state did not.

findings.title: Direct insights navigation issues prohibited /sessions requests
findings.detail: GET http://localhost:8411/sessions occurred at 04:20:16.327Z and 04:20:16.328Z. The banner was correct. No exemption was made for requests possibly originating in the shared shell.

findings.title: Completed-prep persona screen violates zero-error-console criterion
findings.detail: GET /segment/sf7d9d6897a31472895cf5fdeafb9cea1/personas?version=v1 returned 409 three times, with the message that earlier layers must be confirmed. All ten links and all three new screens were present.

findings.title: Stage3 restart keeps stale prep reference and leaves later stages open
findings.detail: UI POST versions from=v1/restartFrom=stage3 created active v2. Session retained prep.derivedRef, prep.status=stale and completion.prepDone=false. The clustering screen remained open; required gate banner never appeared.

findings.title: Insight chatbot UI integration could not be verified
findings.detail: The visible chatbot on /pipeline/insights uses /chat and displayed a valid no-model fallback. /insights immediately redirects. Direct /insight-chat returned 200, proving route survival only; it does not prove the requested insight chatbot UI request path.
